out.explanation: Page 424 defines total secured borrowings (C) as the sum of Total Fund Based (A, 25,249.31 lakhs) and Total Non-Fund Based (B, 23.57 lakhs), which equals 25,272.88 lakhs. Page 137 cites this same aggregate figure (25,272.88 lakhs) as the total outstanding borrowings, showing that the figures represent different components (fund-based vs. non-fund-based facilities) making up the aggregate total rather than a contradiction.
